scope.summary: Implement pose symmetry mirroring, pose blending, and puppeteer-style proximity blending per Section 13.18 (BK-18.3, TAI-BK-066), closing the Daz parity row: L/R pose mirror, deterministic two-pose blend, and N-pose proximity blending (puppeteer blend-board pattern) as pure operations over BodyPoseAsset — all deterministic, all headless.
acceptance_criteria: mirror_pose(&BodyPoseAsset) swaps _l/_r bone transforms with correct quaternion mirroring across the sagittal plane; mirroring twice returns the original within numeric epsilon (involution test), and unpaired center bones (pelvis, spine, head) mirror in place.
blend_poses(a, b, t) interpolates rotations by slerp and translations linearly; t=0 and t=1 reproduce the inputs exactly; blending is deterministic.

puppeteer_blend(poses: &[(BodyPoseAsset, weight)]) produces a normalized proximity-weighted blend of N library poses; degenerate cases (single pose, zero total weight) have typed, documented behavior.
All three operate purely on pose data (no body or GUI dependency) and compose with MT-520 apply (blend result applies through the morph-context lane).
Genital and breast chain bones participate in mirror/blend like any other bones (no special-case exclusion list — verified on a fixture pose with posed penis and breast chains).
scope.risk_if_missed: Mirror and blend are the cheapest pose-authoring multipliers (every asymmetric sex pose has a mirrored variant for free); without them the pose library does double authoring work, and non-deterministic blends would poison replay and pose-asset promotion.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
